title: oekaki catalog
description: What the generated files are called in the language of the place that generated them. This program knows a directory holds files; it does not know that one of them is the estate overview and another is a table of accounts. Everything a reader would call the output by belongs here rather than in the program.

kinds.description: The groups items fall into, in the order they should be shown.

items.description: How to describe a file. The first rule whose pattern matches wins, and a rule's position is also the item's place in the listing, so the order here is the order on screen.

match.description: A shell-style pattern matched against the file name.

hidden.description: Leave matching files out of the listing entirely.

theme.description: CSS custom properties applied to the pages this program serves. Names without the leading dashes.
